items.q: What does social media management include?
items.a: Planning a monthly content calendar, creating and posting content, replying to comments and DMs, running ads where agreed, and a monthly report.

items.q: Can I start with one platform?
items.a: Yes. Most clients start with one or two platforms and add more once they see what is working.

items.q: Do you write the captions and design the posts?
items.a: Yes. Captions, designs and reels are created for your brand, and no caption is recycled from another client.

items.q: How often do we review performance?
items.a: Every month in a review call, with a plain-language report that includes what flopped and what we will change.

items.q: Do you manage LinkedIn for B2B companies?
items.a: Yes. LinkedIn is one of the platforms we manage, matched to the job it does best for your business.
